rule: Temporary compatibility debt must have an owner plus explicit removal/rehome plan and revisit trigger. Open debt never expands public support claims.

entries.summary: Only the declared Chrome 153 / Ubuntu 24.04 x64 CI evidence profile is P0-supported.
entries.removalOrRehomePlan: Run and retain the per-release browser/OS/profile matrix before RC; add profiles only from retained receipts.
entries.revisitTrigger: before RC qualification or any broader browser/OS support claim

entries.summary: Node 24 compatibility is selected/bounded, not full API parity.
entries.removalOrRehomePlan: Expand executable/differential corpus per surface; keep unsupported APIs explicit rather than shimming silently.
entries.revisitTrigger: before a broader Node compatibility claim

entries.summary: Weak-device and long-run resource campaigns are not closed.
entries.removalOrRehomePlan: Run frozen 4/8 GiB, long-run plateau and memory-pressure campaigns; derive support floors from results.

entries.summary: Publish-equivalent package evidence exists but public npm/GitHub Release identity is not closed.
entries.removalOrRehomePlan: Use reviewed release workflow with trusted publication identity, then bind external package/release digest to certified artifact.

entries.summary: Dependency/test-corpus license closure and FTO counsel review remain open.
entries.removalOrRehomePlan: Complete actual-release dependency notices and jurisdiction-specific FTO review; retain decisions without converting engineering analysis into legal conclusions.

entries.summary: Vite toolchain Worker uses a separate CSP profile that admits unsafe-eval while strict guest Workers do not.
entries.removalOrRehomePlan: Keep the privilege isolated to the frozen toolchain Worker; remove the permission if the promoted toolchain no longer requires dynamic code generation.
